_doc: Creative direction that supersedes the frozen source package.
_precedence: v1.0.6 wins on SOURCE TRUTH - claims, locators, evidence, attribution, rights, gates, and the sourced-versus-artistic classification. The directing packs win on CREATIVE DIRECTION - performance, framing intent, sound, rhythm. An override may never change what is true, only how it is shown. Anything here that would alter a claim, a locator, an attribution or a gate is a defect in this file.
_why_this_file_exists: The package is frozen and must never be edited. Where a pack corrects a stale creative note in it, the correction lives here and is applied at prompt-assembly time, so the package stays byte-identical and the correction is still impossible to forget.

prompt_overrides.replace: the edge of her son's draped upper cloth
prompt_overrides.reason: A sleeve is stitched. Everything in this world is draped, and the same prompt's own negative list says 'no stitched garment'. A model given both will draw the sleeve.
prompt_overrides.authority: directing packs, M7 pack section 8 - the one stale note that affects a prompt

prompt_overrides.append: FRAMING: the throne and the dais are OUT OF FRAME. Hold on the lattice light falling across the stone floor and the timber posts. No throne, no dais, no people.
prompt_overrides.reason: The throne must not be seen before the king rises. Venkat, 2026-09-22: he is ON the throne until 01-04 (he rises) and steps down at 01-05; from 01-05 the throne behind them is empty, which 01-07's own action line already says - 'two men on the same level, the empty throne behind'. He is back on it in M2 and leaves it for good at M3/05. The first render of 01-03 showed a wide hall with an EMPTY dais, which would spend film 3's emptying before film 1 has finished. Reframing costs nothing; seating him in shots he is not in would be inventing a presence.
prompt_overrides.authority: the director, 2026-09-22; and the treatment's own standing rule that the throne is occupied in films 1-2

prompt_overrides.append: FRAMING: the throne and the dais are OUT OF FRAME. Frame a ROW of ministers along one wall, close, turning their heads toward the entrance at frame-left - as in the row reference plates. The camera is level with them and the far end of the hall is not seen.

prompt_overrides.append: IN FRAME: he is SEATED, level and unhurried, on a low seat - not standing. Waist up. The staff is at rest, not planted for walking.
prompt_overrides.reason: The shot list says 'seated, level, unhurried' and the render stands him up. The framing note the studio now appends carries size and expression, not `action` - action is a mixed field across the arc (02-18's is '8 s, no move, true silence 0.7 s', a timing note), so it is not pasted into prompts automatically. This shot needs it said, because 02-03 is the still sage: HANDOFF.md §7 carries this one frame into 02-04, 02-13 and into M3/03-02, M4/04-01 and M5/05-01 - 14 shots across four films. A standing sage here is a standing sage in four films. Nothing is invented: the words are the treatment's own.
prompt_overrides.authority: the treatment's own action line for 02-03, 'seated, level, unhurried'

_noted_not_applied.note: 'the only flicker of unease' contradicts M1's own rule against foreshadowing. Direct as unreadable.
beat label 'flesh and blood on the fire'; the source and the narration say the altar.
expression note describes the sage's back; the shot is the king.
expression note describes the empty throne; the shot is the blessing rite.

sound_overrides.reason: The treatment's sound cue puts the water on shot 01-07 at 12.4s. Beat 6 IS the honouring - shot 01-06, 'water at the feet', a vessel, hands, water poured, the sage's nod. 01-07 is the king asking. The directing packs say so outright: 'M1 sound - puts the water at beat 7; it is beat 6.' Confirmed by Laksh on 2026-09-22. Put the richest sound in the film on the gesture it belongs to. The cue's at_s of 12.4s is 01-07's start; it moves with the cue to 01-06's start.
sound_overrides.authority: directing packs, M1 pack line 81 and the stale-notes list; confirmed by the director
sound_overrides.at_s: the start of the cue shot

_continuity_correction.what: The treatment's standing rule reads 'The throne is occupied in films 1-2 and empty from film 3 onward.' Inside M1 that is slightly off.
_continuity_correction.correct: Occupied until 01-04, when he rises. He steps down at 01-05, and from 01-05 the throne behind them is empty - 01-07's action line says so. Occupied again in M2. Empty for good from M3/05.
_continuity_correction.affects: framing only. No claim, locator, attribution or gate moves.
